caption.body:
Hakone — mountain town an hour from Tokyo by bullet train. Famous for hot springs, open-air museums, and views of Mount Fuji on a clear day.

I stayed at a traditional ryokan where they accommodated celiac for a full kaiseki dinner — a very different side of Japan from Tokyo and Kyoto.

Full Hakone guide on the site (link in bio).
